build_delayed_reward_wrapper: build a DelayedRewardWrapper around a dm_env environment to accumulate rewards over N steps
create_sparse_reward_environment: create a sparse reward environment by wrapping with DelayedRewardWrapper and setting accumulation_period to None
test_delayed_reward_step: test the DelayedRewardWrapper step method to verify rewards accumulate and return every N steps
review_delayed_reward_reset: review the DelayedRewardWrapper reset method to verify it clears the delayed reward and accumulation counter
summarize_zero_reward_property: summarize the DelayedRewardWrapper _zero_reward property that creates zero-valued rewards matching the environment reward spec
